head: c48b3b01
gate: Load Reporting Service envelopes, duplex reporting, interval-delta counters with actual elapsed intervals, zero-report skipping, EDS service names, send_all_clusters feature gating and ORCA utilization, reporter, endpoint granularity, foreground scheduler, same-server reconnect, backoff and control-plane failover composition

full_lib.note: The last completed full run predates the reconnect change (same five unrelated failures: http3 DATAGRAM pacing, sibling vort deflate error precedence, WebSocket rejection deadline, MQTT outbound bridge expiry, QUIC endpoint routing). The post-change rerun was terminated by the harness under extreme host load; targeted LRS, xds, delta and package gates passed.

notes: Native tests cover envelopes, locality/dropped counters, endpoint address/port counters, malformed/duplicate/over-limit input, a real loopback report/reconnect stream, opt-in per-cluster unary and streaming counters with in-progress tracking, channel drop attribution with per-category counts, report conversion, EDS service-name propagation from the xDS cluster implementation config, send_all_clusters feature gating, ORCA utilization accumulation and encoding, interval-delta snapshots (including an idle interval and an end-to-end two-interval report) with actual elapsed load_report_interval values, consecutive all-zero report skipping, reporter interval/filter/rebind behavior, endpoint granularity, the foreground scheduler interval/terminal loop, same-server reconnect, scheduler failover to a second control-plane server, and a real two-server ControlPlane failover composition. Official-schema interop evidence is docs/evidence/grpc_lrs/2026-11-03.json.
